Proposed privacy screen and plant benches for our balcony

Five free-standing timber benches, each with a lattice panel behind it, placed against the inside of the balcony wall. Nothing is fixed to the building. This page is for the owners corporation to review and approve.

Loading 3D model

Drag to turn the model. Scroll or pinch to zoom. Right-drag or two-finger drag to move sideways.

What's proposed

Five timber modules stand side by side along the inside of the balcony wall. Each is a two-level plant bench with a square-grid lattice panel fixed to its back. The lattice gives privacy above the wall and supports climbing plants; potted plants sit on the benches.

The modules are separate pieces of furniture. They rest on the balcony floor and can be lifted out at any time.
